summary_rationale: Qualcomm combines an elite, asset-light 31.1% ROIC and a 72.4%-EBT-margin QTL patent licensing vault (with Apple, Huawei, and Transsion renewals locked) with a cyclical fabless QCT semiconductor engine ($37.21B FY26 revenue). While CEO Cristiano Amon's diversification is visibly inflecting—Automotive surged 51.7% YoY to $6.00B and IoT reached $7.13B—and core Arm/Nuvia litigation risk has been neutralized, FY2026 exposed real cyclical and customer-transition friction: Handsets fell 13.4% (-26% in Q4) as Apple scaled its internal C2 modem, QCT EBT margin compressed 330 bps to 27.1%, inventory swelled 32.4% to $8.64B (156 DIO), and GAAP Net Income ($13.63B) was flattered by a $4.21B discrete tax benefit while FCF ($8.65B) and SBC ($3.45B) require disciplined normalization. Compounding durability hinges on FY2027 Data Center ($5B target) and Automotive/IoT growth outpacing the tail-end of Apple modem erosion.
